method: Exact-build events deduplicated by run/sequence/code from both authenticated diagnostic exports. Examine all connections since g517 installation, not only the latest healthy connection. Do not subtract clocks across machines.

failure.interpretation: These retained samples have zero GC pause/stopping increments and 100% observed processor-group busy time. They support host scheduling/load as a contributor, not a proven specific OS API defect or exclusion of all GC/scheduling stalls. Read envelopes include scheduling; process and OS counters are sequential observations.

crossings.interpretation: The 144.761ms input tail contains 143.121ms native submission; the three parent spans total 37us. Contained spans overlap and must not be added. This sample does not support parent mutex admission as the primary B input tail. Trials are uncontrolled and sample counts differ; do not claim a before/after physical latency improvement.

singleTarget: The ACK of advisory boundary-event credit is unnecessary. After a fully written authenticated credit frame, the parent releases its wire mutex without awaiting another ACK. The serial child validates the exact reserved sequence and releases only that reservation, without sending a reply.
quantitativeChange: Per boundary batch: 2 local frames -> 1, 128 -> 64 bytes, 1 ACK wait -> 0. Eliminates the 1s receipt-response timeout path while leaving write deadlines unchanged.
safety: Submission is not applied-input, heartbeat, permission or retirement proof. No epoch, pending request or lastReplyRequestAt is advanced by credit submission.
The ordinary pinned-owner authorization and serial authenticated sequence checks still precede processing. Foreign/duplicate reservation references fail closed.
Only requests proven unsent may retry. Attempted/partial/failed writes stay fatal and never replay.
Heartbeat, activation, native input and retirement retain exact reply matching and existing finite deadlines. Pipe advisory reservation remains at most 1KiB.
Both parent and child images must be updated as the existing matching, authenticated local bundle; there is no peer-network protocol change.
validation: Boundary/native pipe tests and complete inputworker/handoff/residentagent/productlog/localapi suites plus go vet passed. New deterministic tests cover a 1.4s child delay, exact following heartbeat, unchanged active epoch/liveness, invalid/duplicate credit and fatal attempted write. Packaging, installation and subsequent physical results are recorded separately.
remainingRisk: This removes one confirmed fatal waiting path. System saturation, native SendInput stalls and other finite liveness/retirement failures remain possible; no complete root-cause resolution or long-term reliability claim.
delivery: Local g518 rollout to both PCs is authorized; no push or public release requested. No external API, DB, repository hygiene or runner change.
